_about: Speech-to-text engines the app can run on this PC. Model files are downloaded from Hugging Face into <work folder>/models/<dir> only after the user confirms, pinned to one commit and checked by size and SHA-256 (the Moworks Motion kit is not used). The transcript itself is HyperFrames' transcript.json (word level), imported through `hyperframes transcribe`; HyperFrames' own engines (whisper.cpp, Parakeet TDT v3 on Apple Silicon) do not cover Vietnamese on Windows. NVIDIA Parakeet CTC Vietnamese was dropped: it trails Vietnamese-tuned Whisper on natural speech and needs about 5 GB of PyTorch + NeMo. Engines run with faster-whisper (CTranslate2) on the CPU, or the NVIDIA GPU when its CUDA libraries are present. Compared on a Vietnamese voice-over: Whisper turbo was clearly best; EraX WoW Turbo (Vietnamese fine-tune) returned one unpunctuated block with an invented tail and was dropped. Whisper small was dropped: Turbo only, for voice and transcripts; songs are not transcribed, the user gives the lyrics.

runtime.install: Install adds it to the app's Python components

models.label: Whisper large-v3 turbo (faster-whisper)
models.licence: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights, converted to CTranslate2 by deepdml)
models.author: OpenAI; conversion by deepdml
models.note: Recommended: in a Vietnamese ad voice-over test it got the brand, "EGCG", "Thái Nguyên" and most words right (32 s of voice in 18 s on the CPU). Words to expect (brand, script) improve it further. It transcribes speech (voice-overs, interviews), not singing: for a lyric video paste the song's lyrics in the Lyrics step and the app times them.
